analysis.title: Hayward Holdings (HAYW): First Take: Solid 3Q26 beat, FY2026 guidance raised
key_insights: HAYW 3Q26 revenue was $260mn, up 6% yoy, above GSe $253mn and FactSet consensus $252mn. Growth came from +5% net price and +1% volume.
3Q26 adj. EBITDA was about $65mn, above GSe $56mn and consensus $59mn.
3Q26 GAAP gross margin was 47.9%, up 10bps yoy and above GSe 47.5%, helped by a greater contribution from North America relative to Europe & Rest of World.
HAYW raised FY2026 revenue growth guidance to about +5%-6% yoy from about +5%, implying revenue of about $1.18bn-$1.19bn versus GSe/consensus of $1.18bn.
HAYW raised FY2026 adj. EPS guidance to $0.86-$0.88 from $0.84-$0.87. The midpoint is up about 13% yoy and above GSe/consensus of $0.85/$0.86.
North America sales were $226mn, up 9% yoy and above GSe of about $216mn. Adjusted segment income margin was 30.4%, up 80bps yoy.
Europe and RoW sales were $34mn, down 6% yoy and below GSe of $37mn. Adjusted segment income margin was 19.0%, up 50bps yoy.
GS keeps a Neutral rating with a 12-month price target of $14, based on 11X EV/EBITDA applied to Q5-Q8 adj. EBITDA. The stock closed at $13.03 on 27 Oct 2026, implying 7.4% upside.

market_movers.rationale: GS reiterates Neutral with a $14 target after a 3Q26 beat and raised FY2026 guidance. The target uses 11X EV/EBITDA on Q5-Q8 adj. EBITDA and implies 7.4% upside from $13.03.

GS estimates quarterly EPS of $0.13 for 9/26E, $0.32 for 12/26E and $0.14 for 3/27E, after $0.26 in 6/26. GS annual EPS estimates are $0.85 for 12/26E, $0.91 for 12/27E and $0.98 for 12/28E.
